decisions.reason: Rule 11 (revised): 'Implementation was more likely in MDTs with clear goals and processes' (abstract Results p.viii, SS Conclusions p.xxx) and 'High-implementing teams tended to have clear goals' (SS Results p.xxvi, the only place in the SS Results that carries this result) are the same assertion in different wording; one row listing every location, resting on F15, F17, F18 as C4 did (D13). Fit expand: F15, F17, F18 root in F3 through the rule-12 transformations endorsed in D4, and the qualitative comparison explains the measured differences in implementation.
Rule 11 (revised): same assertion recorded twice, replaced by C81; both rows also carried fit single-strand although joint by tracing (D4).

Claim, location and rests_on unchanged.
Fit recorded as single-strand on direct rests_on only; replaced by C82 and C83 with fit expand.
